kind: CUA picker binding observation; no product patch
observation: An early full-path getApp was attempted before product Choose File; it timed out.
After real extension_pick_package and helper spawn, full-path getApp also timed out; parent AX showed disabled empty sheet.
CUA inventory did not list accessory helper; OS process and sampled bundle ID confirmed it was alive in normal NSApplication event wait.
Binding the same existing helper by verified dev.horizon.picker succeeded and exposed native Open panel.
A separate local variable scoping ReferenceError sent no key; operator rebinds at top level.
limitations: Exact reason for full-path CUA binding timeout is unproven; duplicate display name is observed, not claimed as confirmed tool implementation cause.
No product picker failure/repair or installation success is inferred from binding alone.
recommendation: After each real picker open, fresh bind cua.getApp(dev.horizon.picker), then operate current AX.
